title: "Budget and Revenue"
---

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")
```

## Budget and Revenue

@fig-budget-revenue shows the relationship between production budget and worldwide revenue.

```{python}
#| echo: true
#| label: fig-budget-revenue
#| fig-cap: "Production budget and worldwide revenue"

plt.scatter(
    films["budget_musd"],
    films["revenue_musd"]
)

plt.xlabel("Budget (million USD)")
plt.ylabel("Worldwide revenue (million USD)")
plt.show()
```
